title: [Web] Web builds warn about non-supported VSync and "screen kept on" features
body:
### Tested versions - Reproducible on 4.3 and master [36e6207](https://github.com/godotengine/godot/commit/36e6207bb48fafd43b98a458d0c461ad982b4e68) ### System information Godot v4.4.dev (9676b597c) - Web - Single-window, 1 monitor - OpenGL ES 3 (Compatibility) - WebKit WebGL - (2 threads) ### Issue description These errors tend to popup when opening the Web editor:
